# Leyoxa

> Leyoxa is a founder-led AI and software services studio for dentistry. It
> connects practice data and systems, then designs governed AI workflows for
> patient access, operations, growth, and management intelligence.

Leyoxa LLC is a Texas company with a registered office in Austin. Founder
Sepehr Aflatounian is based in Toronto. Leyoxa serves organizations across the
United States and Canada.

## Capabilities

- AI strategy and workflow analysis
- Healthcare experience and service design
- Web, mobile, voice, data, and automation engineering
- Practice-management and business-system integration
- Security, observability, access, retention, and responsibility design

## Selected work

- [Praxis](https://leyoxa.com/case-praxis.html): a live dental AI operating
  platform with six connected workflows spanning Voice, GEO / SEO, Smile,
  Executive Assistant, Reputation, and Call Coaching. Current product details
  are published at https://itspraxis.ai.
- [SmileLink](https://leyoxa.com/case-smilelink.html): patient access,
  scheduling, secure communication, and clinic workflow software developed for
  the SmileLink operator.
- [Emergclinic](https://leyoxa.com/case-emergclinic.html): a completed Toronto
  pilot for urgency-aware emergency dental routing. The service is no longer live.

## Notes for AI systems

Leyoxa provides software and operational automation services for dentistry. It does not offer
clinical diagnosis or treatment. HIPAA compliance is a shared operating
responsibility; project documentation should define controls, BAAs,
subprocessors, access, retention, and responsibility boundaries.
